description:
Unofficial fork build of HushGram 0.0.5 for Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (com.instagram.android) with 49 patches: the 48 from upstream plus Glass tab bar, a floating, rounded glass tab bar in the style of the iPhone one. Glass tab bar starts off; pick it in Morphe Manager's expert mode, then set its switches under Tab bar in HushGram's settings.

Checked on an Android 15 emulator and an Android 16 phone; it hasn't been through upstream's release checks. Read Before you sign in in the README first. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, version code 385511871, and keep the manager's signing key so a new build installs over the old one.
